claims.claim_text: Marco Senesi was definitively suspended for Gameweek 14.
claims.citation_excerpt: Yellow card suspensions: David Brooks (Bournemouth); Marco Senesi (Bournemouth).

claims.claim_text: A BBC FPL expert identified a possible Gameweek 14 benching for Joao Pedro, but the passage was contested opinion rather than manager confirmation.
claims.citation_excerpt: Some Chelsea fans will say he is due a rest and a benching is on the cards whilst others will say he’s due a goal. This could come back to bite me but I think I would be looking to offload him if I didn’t have any other fires to put out in my team.

proposed_adjustments.rationale: A definitive yellow-card suspension makes Senesi unavailable for Gameweek 14.

notes: Both passages were published before the 2025-12-02T18:00:00Z cutoff and are treated as retrospectively recovered pre-deadline evidence.
The Joao Pedro disagreement occurs within a single passage, so it is not represented as a multi-claim conflict.
No Joao Pedro adjustment is proposed because the contested expert opinion does not reach the 0.60 adjustment-confidence threshold.
The Senesi expected-minutes proposal is the sole adjustment for that player and can coherently scale related fields.
All adjustments are proposals only and decrease their baselines.
